_comment: digperiphs wound-SoC configuration: the Castalia defaults with (1) the four Castalia-Quad AFE register stubs + the shared EIS engine stub dropped (peripherals.cqAfeStubs=false) and the QSPI0 flash controller instantiated in their place (peripherals.qspi=true, page-0 slot 12 @0x4C00; vectors 55/56), (2) the I3C0 controller instantiated in the MUTEX page sub-slot 1 (peripherals.i3c=true, @0x6100; vectors 86-93), (3) the NFC0 ISO 14443A tag engine instantiated in the MUTEX page sub-slot 2 (peripherals.nfc=true, @0x6200; vectors 94-97), (4) the RTC0 real-time clock instantiated in the MUTEX page sub-slot 5 (peripherals.rtc=true, @0x6500; vector 114), (5) the PWM0 buffered PWM generator instantiated in the MUTEX page sub-slot 6 (peripherals.pwm=true, @0x6600; vectors 115/116), and (6) the OW0 Dallas/Maxim 1-Wire master instantiated in the MUTEX page sub-slot 7 (peripherals.onewire=true, @0x6700; vector 117, DQ on P6.6/GPIO46 AF1 open-drain rstREN=1). I3C or NFC tightens the mutex-bank decode to its 256 B sub-slot 0; with I3C+NFC the IRQ source list grows to 98 (meip stays frozen at slot 85; I3C 86-93, NFC 94-97) and a 4th glitch-filter instance appears. Enabling RTC0 grows the source list to 115 (vector 114 = RTC0's combined alarm/tick source), enabling PWM0 grows it to 117 (vector 115 = PWM0_FAULT at the lower id, 116 = PWM0_EVT), and enabling OW0 grows it to 118 per the A5 GLOBAL VECTOR RULE (vector 117 = OW0's combined transaction-complete/error source; here 114-117 are ALL real since RTC, PWM and OneWire are on); NUM_EN_WORDS stays 4 (118 <= 128). NFC's digital AFE / RF interface is off-die (placeholder-tied); RTC0 is zero-pin (ungated lfxt_in wall clock, CDC/flags/IRQ on the free-running MCLK); PWM0 is zero-input (free-running MCLK engine, its two outputs pwm_out(0)/(1) replacing the redundant T0CMP0/T0CMP1 spread copies on P2.2/P2.3 AF2, A7); OW0 is single-pin (free-running MCLK engine, one open-drain DQ on P6.6/GPIO46 AF1, DQ 2-FF synchronized). QSPI and AFE stubs are mutually exclusive (both claim page-0 slot 12); I3C, NFC, RTC, PWM, and OneWire are independent of both and of each other. (7) the DMA0 configurable multi-channel single-shot DMA controller instantiated in the MUTEX page sub-slot 8 (peripherals.dma=true, dmaChannels=4, @0x6800; vectors 118/119) -- the FIRST new arbiter MASTER since the four harts, so enabling it WIDENS the shared fabric N=4->5 / MW=3, sh_master 2->3 bits, and the arb_* buses gain a 5th slice (the ONE shared-RTL touch of the digperiphs program). With DMA on the source list grows to 119 (118 = DMA0_DONE, 119 = DMA0_ERR); NUM_EN_WORDS stays 4 (119 <= 128). DMA paces off UART0 (always), and -- because QSPI and NFC are also on in this config -- off QSPI0 RX-full and NFC0 payload-ready too (all three trigger taps live). Everything else is default (the NPU stays ON). Prove with: make verify CONFIG=config/wound.json
